owner_calls.question: The Eminence is filed at Earth-TRN1516, which Marvel Database gives as the universe Strange Supreme creates (where What If...? S3 ends). Marvel Database designates the Eminence himself as 'Multiverse', not one Earth. Keep Earth-TRN1516 or change it?
options: Keep Earth-TRN1516 (the universe where his story ends)
owner_calls.evidence: marvel.fandom.com lists him as 'Eminence (Multiverse)'; Earth-TRN1516 is 'Universe created by Doctor Strange Supreme' (What If...? S2 episode 9 / S3 episode 8).
